'''Jean-Michel Bony''' ({{IPA|fr|ʒɑ̃ miʃɛl bɔni}}; born 1 February 1942 in Paris) is a French mathematician, specializing in [[mathematical analysis]]. He is known for his work on [[microlocal analysis]] and [[pseudodifferential operator]]s.

==Education and career==
Bony completed his undergraduate and graduate studies at the [[École Normale Supérieure]], where he received his Ph.D. in 1972 with thesis advisor [[Gustave Choquet]].<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=80820}}</ref> Bony became a professor at the [[University of Paris-Sud]] and is now a professor at the [[École Polytechnique]].

His doctoral students include [[Jean-Yves Chemin]].

==Research==
Bony's research deals with [[microlocal analysis]], [[partial differential equation]]s and [[potential theory]]. In 1981 he published important results on paradifferential operators, extending the theory of pseudifferential operators published by [[Ronald Coifman]] and [[Yves Meyer]] in 1979.<ref>{{cite journal|author=Bony, J.-M.|title=Calcul symbolique et propagation des singularités pour les équations aux dérivées partielles non linéaires|journal=Annales Scientifiques de l'École Normale Supérieure|volume=14|issue=2|year=1981|pages=209–246|url=http://archive.numdam.org/ARCHIVE/ASENS/ASENS_1981_4_14_2/ASENS_1981_4_14_2_209_0/ASENS_1981_4_14_2_209_0.pdf|doi=10.24033/asens.1404|doi-access=free}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal|url=https://www.ams.org/notices/201007/rtx100700858p.pdf|author=Bényi, Árpád|author2=Maldonado, Diego|author3=Naibo, Virginia|title=What is a paraproduct ?|journal=Notices of the AMS|volume=57|issue=7|pages=858–860|date=August 2010}}</ref> Bony applied his theory to the propagation of singularities in solutions of semilinear wave equations.<ref>Bony, J-M. Second microlocalization and propagation of singularities for semi-linear hyperbolic equations. Université de Paris-Sud. Département de Mathématique, 1985.</ref>

==Recognition==
In 1980, Bony received the [[Prix Paul Doistau–Émile Blutet]]. He was elected a corresponding member and a full member of the French Academy of Sciences in 1990 and 2000 respectively.

He was an Invited Speaker at the [[International Congress of Mathematicians|ICM]] in 1970 in Nice<ref>{{cite book|author=Bony, Jean-Michel|chapter=Uniticité du problème de Cauchy et hypoellipticité pour une classe d'opérateurs différentiels|chapter-url=http://www.mathunion.org/ICM/ICM1970.2/Main/icm1970.2.0691.0696.ocr.pdf|title=Actes, Congrès intern. Math|year=1970|volume=Tome 2|pages=691–696|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160924224839/http://www.mathunion.org/ICM/ICM1970.2/Main/icm1970.2.0691.0696.ocr.pdf|archive-date=2016-09-24|url-status=dead}}</ref> and in 1983 in Warsaw.<ref>{{cite book|chapter-url=http://www.mathunion.org/ICM/ICM1983.2/Main/icm1983.2.1133.1148.ocr.pdf|author=Bony, Jean-Michel|chapter=Propagation et interaction des singularités pour les solutions des équations aux dérivées partielles non-linéaires|title=Proc. of the International Congress of Mathematicians|pages=1133–1147|year=1983|archive-date=2016-09-24|access-date=2016-06-10|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160924224831/http://www.mathunion.org/ICM/ICM1983.2/Main/icm1983.2.1133.1148.ocr.pdf|url-status=dead}}</ref>
